Minimum technical points: fix model and prompts; compare quality, memory, TTFT, TPOT, throughput, concurrency, kernel support, calibration set, and failure cases; report confidence intervals.
corrected_answer:
Assumptions and fair treatment isolation: compare the identical checkpoint, tokenizer, prompt/request trace, decoding limits, serving stack and versions, scheduler, batching policy, hardware/topology, drivers, power and thermal envelope. Change only weight precision; keep activation and KV-cache precision, calibration method, optimization passes, and runtime settings fixed. Record bit width, group size, scales/zero-points, outlier policy, calibration provenance, held-out split, kernel selection, and fallback behavior. Use an authorized disposable environment and redact sensitive telemetry.

Falsifiable hypothesis for scenario variant 221: at each predeclared concurrency level, the quantized arm lowers fully loaded cost per successful output token by a predeclared target, without violating held-out quality, safety, correctness, TTFT, or TPOT gates. Reject the claim if any hard gate fails, the confidence interval misses the target, or unsupported kernels/fallbacks make the comparison non-equivalent.

Keep calibration and held-out sets disjoint. After equal warm-up and compilation, preregister sample size, scoring rubric, exclusions, stopping rule, and confidence-interval method. Run repeated randomized interleaved paired baseline/treatment trials on the same request mix. Measure peak/steady memory in GiB, TTFT and TPOT in ms, throughput in tokens/s, queueing, concurrency, cost components and cost per successful token, quality/safety/correctness scores, errors, timeouts, OOMs, retries, partial outputs, cleanup, kernel support, and fallback rate. Report distributions, units, strata, and intervals.

Control or record thermal throttling, cache state, compilation, scheduler contention, background load, request/output lengths, retry policy, and kernel changes; stratify or invalidate compromised trials. Require evidence of versioned configs, raw per-request metrics, calibration/held-out provenance, kernel and fallback logs, and failure/cleanup records. Roll out only through an authorized bounded canary; stop on safety/correctness regression or predeclared latency, error, OOM, or quality thresholds, then restore the known-good configuration.
